effects.label: Shock
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 125% damage from incoming attacks.

levels.text:
Spawns a Shocksphere that follows Taranis, lasting 10s. 
The Shocksphere attacks 1 random enemy in a 15m radius around Taranis, from a distance of 9m, every 1s, dealing 48 damage per hit. Each hit casts a [Shock] debuff on the target, lasting 2s. Shocked targets cannot move or use Skills, and take increased damage from attacks (125%), but their Skill Cooldowns will behave as normal. 
The [Shock] debuff from the Shocksphere attacks will not be cast on the same target twice within 7s. 
Deals 50% more damage to targets that are immune to [Shock] debuffs.
Accuracy required for: Shock
#1 Damage: 54% ATK

bio: Born 17th in the line of Eldrin succession, Taranis abandoned his lineage when he became one with the wild magics coursing through Amara. Sustained by pure energy, he had no need for titles. Taranis now inhabits a Shred of pure energy, entreating with its elementals and surveilling Amara's leylines for signs of contamination.
